**Important Note:**
This competition is a twin competition alongside [Sydney Re-Open Saturday 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SydneyReOpenSaturday2021). **Competitors are permitted to attend ONLY ONE of these competitions.** More information can be found on the Information tab. Please note that each competition has a different set of events.

Please also read the Information tab carefully to make sure you understand the COVID-safe requirements. Guests are limited to strictly one per competitor.

**Contact us**
